summary: Defines a MIB module for managing SONET and SDH interfaces, the optical transmission systems carriers use. It is a companion to the DS1/E1 and DS3/E3 MIB documents. It obsoletes RFC 1595 and was replaced by RFC 3592.

eli5.summary: This is a standard set of gauges for the fast fiber-optic lines of phone companies, so any monitoring program can read them.
